## What was decided

The second review of PR #844 head `86732efcc` approved the detector change
and the review-round delegation ledger, but blocked approval because the
branch was 18 commits behind main `304cd075b` with same-file drift from
#831/#832 (reviewer checklist item 12, "Up-to-date & conflict-free"). This
round rebases the three `lab:` commits onto `304cd075b`, re-runs the full
verification on the rebased head, and updates the recorded verification
head and artifact measurements. No code adaptation was needed: the replay
was conflict-free and the rebased tree is functionally identical.

The reviewer's non-blocking hash finding is also resolved. The recorded
`ca8d18e1...` hash reproduces from the common-indent de-indent with the
trailing newline included. The reviewer's `44874ff3...` is the
per-line-lstrip spelling of the same six-line function body. The
review-round record now states the extraction explicitly and carries both
hashes, so the byte-identical claim is reproducible either way.
